newsitem.title: USA: Colossal buys plant for processing cobalt.
newsitem.headline: Colossal buys plant for processing cobalt.

text.p: Colossal Resources Corp said it bought equipment to produce high grade cobalt products from cobalt-rich alloy produced by the company's recently commissioned KMPP slag processing plant near Kabwe in Zambia.
Colossal has acquired pilot hydrometallurgical processing facilities which are being installed and upgraded on a leased site in Johannesburg, South Africa.
A new subsidiary, SACOLCo Pty, will operate the plant which is expected to become operational within the next 60 days, Colossal said in a statement.
Colossal will be capable of producing commercial grade cobalt chemicals, sulphate and hydroxide, and or oxide at a rate of about 10,000 kilograms of contained cobalt per month.

"This acquisition is part of our mid-term strategy to move quickly to generate revenues from value-added cobalt products for which there are important market opportunities in Asia, India and Japan," Colossal's president and chief executive officer, Dil Gujral said.
Colossal also plans to add a similar processing facility to the Kabwe plant.
